mechanism_definition.global_half: scale_half_tangent preserves recipient tangent directions and reassigns inverse-norm scales by stable rank/half rotation within eligible histories. mechanism_definition.latest_difference: Use native full normalization derivatives when supplied history_mask count<=16; otherwise retain global-half donor derivatives. observations.statement: Resolved all94 committed own-arm receipts:90 successful validations and four trace-v1 execution failures. Current history exactly matches corresponding complete receipts. Every successful validation has3,234,051 impressions. The94 jobs are dependent controls, source variants and replays, not independent seeds.
Static, simple-pooling and target-aware reference AUCs are0.6050036145,0.6102261137 and0.6133619861. This benchmark benefits from history and target conditioning at seed42.

The latest candidate loses0.00015098405147961902 population AUC and increases Logloss by0.0001934596949558498 versus its CONFIG-matched global-half control. Both executions succeeded; this is a scientific negative, not missing data or an execution failure.

The control exactly reproduces round30 aligned-half AUC, Logloss, sample count and all23 slice dictionaries; source hashes and timings differ. Aggregate replay does not establish identical predictions, checkpoint states or independent-seed support.

For1-16 events, fallback gains0.00011780797416893751 AUC and reduces loss by0.00017644754093162907 versus global half. Empty-history AUC falls0.0018715916733517135 while loss improves0.0005649602707495649. Both short bins remain worse than historical global full on both metrics.

The<=16 group has50,077 impressions and1,754 positives,1.54843% of validation. Its weighted loss contribution improves3.7258969658447422e-6, outweighed by the>16 group worsening1.9718559192132468e-4. This exactly decomposes overall mean Logloss; overall AUC cannot be decomposed by weighting within-slice AUCs.

Only4/23 overlapping slices improve AUC and4/23 improve Logloss. All four hour bins lose AUC and loss. Frequency1-2 gains AUC but loses loss; frequency>=100 improves both. These are exploratory counts of overlapping slices, not independent replications or significance tests.

Schema11 reports active routing flags0/1, cutoff16, no observers/row intervention, zero sampled fixed-state forward error and finite logits. The ordered512-input sample contains10 short rows, four empty rows and41 short regular events; natural floor/boundary events are absent. Synthetic f32/f64 routing checks include lengths16/17; maximum reported f32 scaled VJP error is1.23618e-6. These checks are candidate-authored, not independent verification.

Capacity is17,130,275 parameters in both latest arms. Fallback costs5.6431642 more train seconds and6.7756455 more wall seconds, about1.07%/1.10%, with4096 more peak GPU bytes. Inference throughput falls198559 to196102 examples/s; batch p50/p95 rise19.037/19.913 to19.309/20.352ms. One timing pair supports no stable efficiency conclusion.

Full count balancing harms both pooling and target-aware references; half balancing improves pooling but harms target-aware AUC. Aligned products improve the local reference, while constant/history-mean controls nearly match fuller normalization; action-conditioned allocation is negative. These branches limit a universal behavior-balancing or semantic-retrieval story.

The inherited common-implementation pairing-by-gradient factorial favors half in both pairings. Crossed gain0.0004667050401 exceeds aligned gain0.0001204973277; the AUC interaction is+0.0003462077124. This is one-seed performance nonadditivity, not semantic or optimizer mediation.

Historical magnitude AUC maximum0.6152795937 drops to0.6149279139 on same-source exact17 replay. Round26 magnitude has a small positive contrast while round27 is negative; same-source duplicate magnitude results also vary. The historical maximum remains recorded, with no stable incremental magnitude benefit established.

Inference shortcut and identity-transport branches preserve reported quality. Round32 has sub-percent train/wall savings but slower inference in one pair; round31 inference gain is also unrepeated. Preserve these as implementation trajectories, with no robust cost frontier.

Four trace-v1 receipts fail before validation with RuntimeError: Trace v1 supports float32/64 only; preserve failure. Their measured wall sum is21.4754219353199 seconds; metrics are null. They consume budget and provide no performance estimate.

Latest knowledge usage is documented with no undocumented industry IDs. Both executed variant names, hashes and statuses match committed receipts. The agent-r0030 directional routing use was executed, but its joint short-recovery/population-preservation prediction did not succeed.

interpretations.statement: The derivative gate is active and passes bounded checks, making an obviously disabled intervention less likely. Candidate-authored synthetic and512-input checks cannot prove training-wide implementation correctness.

Further cutoff/coefficient/architecture searches on the same validation seed would add adaptive selection without resolving the main uncertainty: whether the existing gain survives paired initializations and closed assessment.
